translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Personnel Section and ordered to pacify displaced people in Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 景泰改元，給事中李實請於四川行都司設鎮守大臣，乃遷固大理右少卿，鎮建昌。

translations.literal: When the reign title was changed to Jingtai, Supervising Secretary Li Shi requested that a garrisoning great minister be established at the Sichuan regional command; Gu was therefore transferred to Right Vice Minister of the Court of Judicial Review and garrisoned Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: When the reign title changed to Jingtai, Supervising Secretary Li Shi asked for a garrisoning senior minister at the Sichuan regional command; Zhang Gu was transferred to Right Vice Minister of the Court of Judicial Review and garrisoned Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 有政績。

translations.literal: He had achievements in governance.
translations.idiomatic: He achieved notable governance.

sentences.zh: 三年還理寺事。

translations.literal: In the third year he returned to handle court affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he returned to handle court affairs.

sentences.zh: 山東盜起，奉命督捕。

translations.literal: Bandits rose in Shandong, and he was ordered to supervise their suppression.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits rose in Shandong, he was ordered to supervise their suppression.

sentences.zh: 適霖潦災，流人載道，固盡心振釁，盜賊弭散。

translations.literal: It happened that continuous rain and flooding caused disasters, and refugees filled the roads; Gu devoted himself wholeheartedly to relief, and the bandits dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: Continuous rain and flooding brought disaster, and refugees filled the roads; Zhang Gu devoted himself to relief, and the bandits dispersed.

sentences.zh: 還，卒於官。

translations.literal: On his return he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he died in office.

sentences.zh: 固在諫職敢言，大臣多被彈劾，又劾都御史陳鎰等舉屬官出身掾吏者為知府。

translations.literal: While in remonstrance office he dared to speak out; many great ministers were impeached by him, and he also impeached Censor-in-Chief Chen Yi and others for appointing subordinate officials who were former clerks as prefects.
translations.idiomatic: In remonstrance office he spoke boldly; he impeached many senior ministers and also impeached Censor-in-Chief Chen Yi for appointing former clerks as prefects.

sentences.zh: 自是掾吏不得曆知府，著為例。

translations.literal: From then on clerks could not rise to prefect, and this was fixed as a precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter clerks could not become prefects, and this was fixed as precedent.

sentences.zh: 英宗將北征，偕同官疏諫。

translations.literal: When Emperor Yingzong was about to campaign north, he joined his colleagues in memorializing in remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yingzong was about to campaign north, he joined colleagues in memorializing in protest.

sentences.zh: 復辟，追念之，已卒。

translations.literal: After the restoration, the emperor recalled him with favor, but he had already died.
translations.idiomatic: After the restoration the emperor recalled him with favor, but he had already died.

sentences.zh: 遣使諭祭，官其一子。

translations.literal: An envoy was dispatched to offer sacrifices, and one son was given an official post.
translations.idiomatic: An envoy was sent to offer sacrifices, and one son was given an official post.

sentences.zh: 子黼，仕至廣西按察使。

translations.literal: His son You served up to Surveillance Commissioner of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: His son You rose to Surveillance Commissioner of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 張瑄，字廷璽，江浦人。

translations.literal: Zhang Xuan, style name Tingxi, was a native of Jiangpu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xuan, whose style name was Tingxi, came from Jiangpu.

sentences.zh: 正統七年進士。

translations.literal: He became a jinshi in the seventh year of Zhengtong.
translations.idiomatic: He received his jinshi degree in the seventh year of Zhengtong.

sentences.zh: 授刑部主事，曆郎中，有能聲。

translations.literal: He was appointed a director in the Ministry of Justice and served in succession as director, gaining a reputation for ability.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed a director in the Ministry of Justice and rose through the ranks with a reputation for ability.

sentences.zh: 景泰時，賜敕為吉安知府。

translations.literal: During Jingtai he was granted an imperial commission as prefect of Jian.
translations.idiomatic: During Jingtai he was granted an imperial commission as prefect of Jian.

sentences.zh: 俗尚巫，迎神無休日。

translations.literal: The custom favored shamans, and welcoming the gods had no day of rest.
translations.idiomatic: Local custom favored shamans, and spirit-welcoming rites never ceased.

sentences.zh: 瑄遇諸途，設神水中。

translations.literal: When Xuan met them on the road, he set up a bowl of spirit-water.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Xuan met them on the road, he set out a bowl of spirit-water.

sentences.zh: 俄遘危疾，父老皆言神為祟，請復之。

translations.literal: Soon he fell gravely ill; the elders all said the god was afflicting him and begged that the rites be restored.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he fell gravely ill; elders said the god was afflicting him and begged that the rites be restored.

sentences.zh: 瑄怒，不許，疾亦愈。

translations.literal: Xuan was angry and would not consent; his illness also recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xuan refused angrily, and his illness also recovered.

sentences.zh: 歲大饑，陳牒上官，不俟報，輒發廩振貸。

translations.literal: In a year of great famine he submitted documents to his superiors and, without awaiting reply, opened granaries for relief loans.
translations.idiomatic: During a great famine he reported to superiors and, without awaiting approval, opened granaries for relief grain and loans.

sentences.zh: 居八年，用薦擢廣東右布政使。

translations.literal: After eight years in office, on recommendation he was promoted to Right Administrative Commissioner of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: After eight years, on recommendation he was promoted to Right Administrative Commissioner of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 廣西賊莫文章等越境陷連山，瑄擊斬之。

translations.literal: The Guangxi bandit Mo Wenzhang and others crossed the border and seized Lianshan; Xuan attacked and beheaded them.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi bandit Mo Wenzhang and others crossed the border and seized Lianshan; Zhang Xuan attacked and beheaded them.

sentences.zh: 又破陽山賊周公轉、新興賊鄧李保等。

translations.literal: He also defeated the Yangshan bandit Zhou Gongzhuan and the Xinxing bandit Deng Libao and others.
translations.idiomatic: He also defeated Yangshan bandit Zhou Gongzhuan and Xinxing bandit Deng Libao and others.

sentences.zh: 既而大藤峽賊頻陷屬邑，瑄坐停俸。

translations.literal: Later the bandits of Dateng Gorge frequently seized subordinate districts, and Xuan was penalized by suspension of salary.
translations.idiomatic: Later Dateng Gorge bandits frequently seized subordinate districts, and Zhang Xuan had his salary suspended.

sentences.zh: 成化初，韓雍平賊，錄瑄轉餉勞，賜銀幣，給俸如初。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chenghua, Han Yong pacified the bandits; Xuan merit in transporting provisions was recorded, and he was granted silver and silk and his salary restored.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Chenghua Han Yong pacified the bandits; Zhang Xuan merit in transporting provisions was recorded, and he received silver, silk, and restored salary.

sentences.zh: 瑄按行所部，督建預備倉六十二，修陂塘圩岸四千六百，增築廣州新會諸城垣一十二。

translations.literal: Xuan toured his jurisdiction and supervised the building of sixty-two reserve granaries, repaired 4,600 embankments, ponds, and dikes, and added or repaired twelve city walls in Guangzhou, Xinhui, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xuan toured his jurisdiction, supervised construction of sixty-two reserve granaries, repaired 4,600 embankments and dikes, and strengthened twelve city walls in Guangzhou, Xinhui, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 民德瑄，惟恐其去。

translations.literal: The people were grateful to Xuan and feared only that he would leave.
translations.idiomatic: The people were grateful to Zhang Xuan and feared only that he would leave.

sentences.zh: 既轉左布政使，會滿九載，當赴京，軍民相率乞留。

translations.literal: After he was transferred to Left Administrative Commissioner, when his nine-year term was due and he was to go to the capital, soldiers and civilians together begged that he remain.
translations.idiomatic: After promotion to Left Administrative Commissioner, when his nine-year term ended and he was to go to the capital, soldiers and civilians begged him to stay.

sentences.zh: 巡撫陳濂等為之請，乃仍故任。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Chen Lian and others memorialized on their behalf, and he was therefore kept in his former post.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Chen Lian and others memorialized on their behalf, and he remained in his former post.

sentences.zh: 八年始以右副都御史巡撫福建。

translations.literal: Only in the eighth year was he appointed Right Vice Censor-in-Chief to tour and pacify Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Only in the eighth year was he appointed Right Vice Censor-in-Chief to tour and pacify Fujian.

sentences.zh: 平賊林壽六、魏懷三等。

translations.literal: He pacified the bandits Lin Shouliu, Wei Huaisan, and others.
translations.idiomatic: He pacified bandits Lin Shouliu, Wei Huaisan, and others.

sentences.zh: 福安、壽甯諸縣鄰江、浙，賊首葉旺、葉春等負險。

translations.literal: The counties of Fuan and Shouning bordered Jiangsu and Zhejiang; the bandit chiefs Ye Wang, Ye Chun, and others held difficult terrain.
translations.idiomatic: The counties of Fuan and Shouning bordered Jiangsu and Zhejiang; bandit chiefs Ye Wang, Ye Chun, and others held difficult terrain.

sentences.zh: 瑄捕誅之，餘盡解散。

translations.literal: Xuan captured and executed them, and the rest were all dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xuan captured and executed them, and the rest dispersed.

sentences.zh: 帝降敕勞之，改撫河南。

translations.literal: The emperor issued a decree commending him and transferred him to tour and pacify Henan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor issued a commendation and transferred him to serve as grand coordinator of Henan.

sentences.zh: 議事入都，陳撫流民、振滯才十八事，所司多議行。

translations.literal: When he entered the capital to discuss affairs, he presented eighteen items on pacifying displaced people and reviving stagnant talent; most were debated and carried out by the relevant offices.
translations.idiomatic: Entering the capital to discuss policy, he presented eighteen proposals on resettling refugees and reviving neglected talent; most were adopted.

sentences.zh: 黃河水溢，瑄請振，且移王府祿米於他所，留應輸榆林餉濟荒，石取直八錢輸榆林，民稱便。

translations.literal: When the Yellow River overflowed, Xuan requested relief and also proposed moving the princely establishment grain rations elsewhere, retaining grain destined for Yulin supplies to relieve famine, and taking eight qian per shi in cash for Yulin transport—the people praised the convenience.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yellow River flooded, Zhang Xuan requested relief, proposed relocating princely grain stores, and used commuted grain funds to relieve famine and supply Yulin at eight qian per shi, which the people welcomed.

sentences.zh: 還理院事。

translations.literal: He returned to handle court affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to handle court affairs.

sentences.zh: 尋遷南京刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Vice Minister of Justice at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to Vice Minister of Justice at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 久之，進尚書。

translations.literal: After a long time he was promoted to Minister.
translations.idiomatic: After some time he was promoted to minister.

sentences.zh: 二十年，星變，被劾，帝弗問。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year there was a change in the stars; he was impeached, but the emperor did not inquire into it.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, after a celestial anomaly, he was impeached, but the emperor took no action.

sentences.zh: 居三年，給事御史復劾之，遂落職。

translations.literal: After three years in office, supervising secretaries and censors again impeached him, and he was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: After three years, remonstrating officials impeached him again, and he was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 孝宗立，復官，致仕。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaozong took the throne, his office was restored and he retired.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaozong took the throne, his office was restored and he retired.

sentences.zh: 張鵬，字騰霄，淶水人。

translations.literal: Zhang Peng, style name Tengxiao, was a native of Laishui.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Peng, whose style name was Tengxiao, came from Laishui.

sentences.zh: 景泰二年進士。

translations.literal: He became a jinshi in the second year of Jingtai.
translations.idiomatic: He received his jinshi degree in the second year of Jingtai.

sentences.zh: 授御史。

translations.literal: He was appointed censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed a censor.

sentences.zh: 上疏言：「懷利事君，人臣所戒。

translations.literal: He memorialized, saying: "Seeking profit in serving the ruler is what subjects must guard against.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Serving the ruler for profit is what subjects must guard against.

sentences.zh: 比每遇聖節，或進羊馬錦綺，交錯殿廷。

translations.literal: Recently, whenever a sacred festival occurs, sheep, horses, brocades, and silks are presented, filling the court hall in confusion.
translations.idiomatic: Recently at every imperial festival, sheep, horses, brocades, and silks are presented until the hall is crowded.

sentences.zh: 自非貪賄，安有餘財充進奉？

translations.literal: Unless they were greedy for bribes, how could they have surplus wealth for tribute?
translations.idiomatic: Unless they were taking bribes, how could they have surplus wealth for tribute?

sentences.zh: 且陛下富有四海，豈借是足國哉？

translations.literal: Moreover, Your Majesty possesses the wealth of the four seas—how could such things enrich the state?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Your Majesty possesses the wealth of the four seas—how could such gifts enrich the state?

sentences.zh: 宜一切停罷，塞諂諛奔競之途。

translations.literal: All such presentations ought to be stopped entirely, blocking the path of flattery and frantic competition.
translations.idiomatic: All such presentations ought to cease, blocking the path of flattery and frantic competition.

sentences.zh: 」疏凡四事，帝頗採用。

translations.literal: The memorial contained four items in all, and the emperor adopted several of them.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial contained four proposals, several of which the emperor adopted.

sentences.zh: 出按大同、宣府，奏：「兩鎮軍士敝衣菲食，病無藥，死無棺。

translations.literal: He went out to tour Datong and Xuanfu and memorialized: "The soldiers of the two garrisons wear ragged clothes and eat poor food; when ill they have no medicine, and when dead they have no coffins.
translations.idiomatic: Touring Datong and Xuanfu, he memorialized: "Soldiers of the two garrisons wear rags and eat poorly; when ill they lack medicine, and when dead they lack coffins.

sentences.zh: 乞官給醫藥、棺槥，設義塚，俾饗曆祭。

translations.literal: I beg that the government supply medicine and coffins, establish charitable burial grounds, and enable seasonal sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that the government supply medicine and coffins, establish charitable burial grounds, and enable seasonal sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 死者蒙恩，則生者勸。

translations.literal: If the dead receive grace, the living will be encouraged.
translations.idiomatic: If the dead receive grace, the living will be encouraged.

sentences.zh: 」帝立報可，且命諸邊概行之。

translations.literal: The emperor at once approved and ordered all frontiers to implement the practice generally.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved at once and ordered all frontiers to follow suit.

sentences.zh: 奏停淮、揚征賦，給牛種。

translations.literal: He memorialized to stop tax levies in Huai and Yang and to provide oxen and seed.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to halt tax levies in Huai and Yang and to provide oxen and seed.

sentences.zh: 成化四年，以右僉都御史巡撫廣西，剿蠻寇有功。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chenghua, as Right Vice Censor-in-Chief he toured and pacified Guangxi and achieved merit in suppressing southern bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Chenghua, as Right Vice Censor-in-Chief he pacified Guangxi and achieved merit suppressing southern bandits.

sentences.zh: 其冬罷巡撫官，命還理南京都察院事。

translations.literal: That winter the touring pacification posts were abolished, and he was ordered to return and handle affairs at the Nanjing Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: That winter touring pacification posts were abolished, and he returned to handle affairs at the Nanjing Censorate.

sentences.zh: 改督漕運，兼撫淮、揚四府。

translations.literal: He was transferred to supervise grain transport and concurrently pacify the four prefectures of Huai and Yang.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to supervise grain transport and concurrently pacify Huai and Yang.

sentences.zh: 尋解漕務，專理巡撫事。

translations.literal: Soon he was relieved of transport duties and devoted himself solely to pacification.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was relieved of transport duties and devoted himself solely to pacification.

sentences.zh: 復還南院，進副都御史，巡撫寧夏。

translations.literal: He returned again to the southern court, was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief, and toured and pacified Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to the southern court, was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief, and pacified Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 召還，曆兵部左、右侍郎。

translations.literal: He was recalled and served in succession as Left and Right Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled and served as Left and Right Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 十八年代陳鉞為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he replaced Chen Yue as Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he replaced Chen Yue as Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 守珠池宦官韋助乞往來高、肇、瓊、廉，會守巡官捕寇。

translations.literal: The eunuch Wei Zhu, keeper of the pearl pool, begged to travel through Gao, Zhao, Qiong, and Lian and join garrison and touring officials in capturing bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuch Wei Zhu, keeper of the pearl pool, asked to travel through Gao, Zhao, Qiong, and Lian to join officials in capturing bandits.

sentences.zh: 鵬執不可，帝竟許之。

translations.literal: Peng insisted this could not be done, but the emperor ultimately permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Peng insisted this could not be done, but the emperor permitted it anyway.

sentences.zh: 南北印馬，率遣勳臣、內侍，後以災傷止遣御史。

translations.literal: For north-south horse branding, meritorious officials and inner attendants were usually sent; later, because of disaster and injury, only censors were sent.
translations.idiomatic: For north-south horse branding, meritorious officials and eunuchs were usually sent; later only censors were sent because of disasters.

sentences.zh: 是年，帝復欲遣內侍，鵬等執不可。

translations.literal: That year the emperor again wished to send inner attendants; Peng and others insisted it could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: That year the emperor again wished to send eunuchs; Zhang Peng and others objected.

sentences.zh: 帝勉從之，命俟後仍如故事。

translations.literal: The emperor reluctantly consented and ordered that afterward the old practice should still be followed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor reluctantly agreed but ordered that the old practice resume later.

sentences.zh: 鎮守大同中官汪直言小王子將大舉，請發京兵援。

translations.literal: The Datong garrison eunuch Wang Zhi said outright that the Little Prince was about to launch a major attack and begged that capital troops be sent as reinforcements.
translations.idiomatic: Datong garrison eunuch Wang Zhi said the Little Prince was about to attack in force and begged for capital reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 鵬等言：「大同士馬四萬已足用，所請宜勿許。

translations.literal: Peng and others said: "Datong already has 40,000 troops and horses, which are sufficient; the request ought not be granted.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Peng and others said: "Datong already has 40,000 troops, which are sufficient; the request should be denied.

sentences.zh: 且京軍困營造，精力銷沮，猝有急，何以作威厲氣，請悉停其役。

translations.literal: Moreover, capital troops are worn out by construction work and their strength is exhausted; if there is a sudden emergency, how can they display awe-inspiring spirit? I beg that all such labor be stopped entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, capital troops are exhausted by construction; if emergency strikes, how can they fight? I beg that such labor cease entirely.

sentences.zh: 」詔可。

translations.literal: An edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved.

sentences.zh: 尋加太子少保。

translations.literal: Soon he was advanced to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 鵬初為御史，剛直尚氣節，有盛名。

translations.literal: When Peng first served as censor he was upright and valued integrity, enjoying a great reputation.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Peng first served as censor he was upright and principled, enjoying a great reputation.

sentences.zh: 後揚曆中外，惟事安靜。

translations.literal: Later, as he rose through central and outer posts, he sought only quiet in affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Later, rising through central and provincial posts, he sought only quiet in affairs.

sentences.zh: 群小竊柄，閣臣萬安、劉吉輩專營私，鵬循職而已，不能有所匡救。

translations.literal: Petty men usurped power, and Grand Secretaries Wan An, Liu Ji, and others devoted themselves to private gain; Peng merely performed his duties and could not correct them.
translations.idiomatic: Petty men usurped power while Grand Secretaries Wan An and Liu Ji pursued private gain; Zhang Peng merely performed his duties and could not correct them.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，星變，鵬偕僚屬言：「傳奉武職至八百餘人，乞悉令閑住，非軍功毋濫授。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, when the stars changed, Peng joined his colleagues in saying: "Honorary military posts granted by special commission number more than 800; I beg that all be ordered to idle status, and that no appointment be made without military merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, after a celestial anomaly, Zhang Peng joined colleagues in saying: "Honorary military posts now exceed 800; I beg all be idled and none granted without military merit.

sentences.zh: 四方鎮守、監槍、守備內官，非正統間原設者，悉宜召還。

translations.literal: Eunuchs garrisoning the regions, supervising firearms, and holding guard posts throughout the realm, if not originally established in the Zhengtong period, ought all to be recalled.
translations.idiomatic: Regional garrison eunuchs, firearm supervisors, and guard-post eunuchs not originally established in Zhengtong ought all be recalled.

sentences.zh: 」廷臣亦交以請，下兵部復核。

translations.literal: Court officials also jointly requested this; the matter was sent to the Ministry of War for review.
translations.idiomatic: Court officials also jointly requested this; the matter went to the Ministry of War for review.

sentences.zh: 鵬畏中官，不敢堅其議，帝遂盡留之。

translations.literal: Peng feared the eunuchs and did not insist on his proposal; the emperor therefore kept them all.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Peng feared the eunuchs and did not insist; the emperor kept them all.

sentences.zh: 時論皆咎鵬。

translations.literal: Public opinion at the time all blamed Peng.
translations.idiomatic: Public opinion blamed Zhang Peng.

sentences.zh: 奸民章瑾獻珍寶，得為錦衣鎮撫。

translations.literal: The villain Zhang Jin presented precious objects and was made a garrison commander of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The villain Zhang Jin presented treasures and was made an Embroidered-Uniform Guard commander.

sentences.zh: 理刑缺，鵬所上不允。

translations.literal: A post in judicial review was vacant; Peng's recommendation was not approved.
translations.idiomatic: A judicial review post was vacant; Zhang Peng's recommendation was denied.

sentences.zh: 知帝意屬瑾，即推用焉。

translations.literal: Knowing the emperor's mind favored Jin, he at once recommended him for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing the emperor favored Jin, he recommended him at once.

sentences.zh: 台諫劾大臣不職者多及鵬，鵬力求去，遂賜敕給驛以歸。

translations.literal: Censors and remonstrators impeaching incompetent great ministers often included Peng; Peng strongly sought to leave office and was granted an imperial edict, relay horses, and return home.
translations.idiomatic: Censors impeaching incompetent ministers often included Zhang Peng; he sought to leave office and was granted an edict, relay horses, and return home.

sentences.zh: 弘治四年卒。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Hongzhi he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fourth year of Hongzhi.

sentences.zh: 諡懿簡。

translations.literal: He was given the posthumous name Yijian.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the posthumous title Yijian.

sentences.zh: 李裕，字資德，豐城人。

translations.literal: Li Yu, style name Zide, was a native of Fengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yu, whose style name was Zide, came from Fengcheng.

sentences.zh: 景泰五年進士。

translations.literal: He became a jinshi in the fifth year of Jingtai.
translations.idiomatic: He received his jinshi degree in the fifth year of Jingtai.

sentences.zh: 授御史。

translations.literal: He was appointed censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed a censor.

sentences.zh: 天順中，巡按陝西，上安邊八事。

translations.literal: During Tianshun he toured Shaanxi and presented eight items on securing the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: During Tianshun he toured Shaanxi and presented eight proposals for securing the frontier.

sentences.zh: 石彪濫報首功，詔裕核實。

translations.literal: Shi Biao falsely reported merit for heads taken; an edict ordered Yu to verify the facts.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Biao falsely reported merit; an edict ordered Li Yu to verify the facts.

sentences.zh: 彪從父亨以書抵裕，裕焚之，以實聞。

translations.literal: Biao's uncle by marriage Heng sent Yu a letter; Yu burned it and reported the facts.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Biao's uncle by marriage Shi Heng sent Li Yu a letter; Yu burned it and reported the truth.

sentences.zh: 亨亦旋敗。

translations.literal: Heng soon fell as well.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Heng soon fell as well.

sentences.zh: 由是有強直聲。

translations.literal: From this he gained a reputation for stern integrity.
translations.idiomatic: From this he gained a reputation for stern integrity.

sentences.zh: 都御史寇深遇僚屬嚴，惟裕不為屈。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Kou Shen was severe toward colleagues, but only Yu did not yield.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Kou Shen was severe toward colleagues, but only Li Yu did not yield.

sentences.zh: 以才擢山東按察使。

translations.literal: Because of his talent he was promoted to Surveillance Commissioner of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: For his talent he was promoted to Surveillance Commissioner of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 重囚二百餘人，或經十餘年未判，裕旬月間決遣殆盡。

translations.literal: More than 200 serious prisoners, some untried for more than ten years, were all decided and dispatched within about a month.
translations.idiomatic: More than 200 serious prisoners, some untried for over ten years, were all decided within a month.

sentences.zh: 大峴山賊寨七十餘，裕捕戮其魁，縱脅從，除其逋負，亂遂平。

translations.literal: There were more than seventy bandit stockades on Mount Daxian; Yu captured and executed the chiefs, released those coerced to follow, and remitted their tax arrears, and the disorder was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On Mount Daxian more than seventy bandit stockades were pacified when Yu executed the chiefs, released followers, and remitted tax arrears.

sentences.zh: 成化初，遷陝西左布政使，入為順天府尹。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chenghua he was transferred to Left Administrative Commissioner of Shaanxi and entered the capital as prefect of Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Chenghua he became Left Administrative Commissioner of Shaanxi, then entered the capital as prefect of Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 政聲大著。

translations.literal: His reputation for governance was greatly renowned.
translations.idiomatic: His reputation for governance was greatly renowned.

sentences.zh: 進右副都御史，總督漕運兼巡撫江北諸府。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief, supervising grain transport and concurrently touring and pacifying the prefectures of northern Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief, supervising grain transport and pacifying northern Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 浚白塔、孟瀆二河以便漕。

translations.literal: He dredged the Baita and Mengdu Rivers to facilitate transport.
translations.idiomatic: He dredged the Baita and Mengdu Rivers to facilitate grain transport.

sentences.zh: 張秋南旺及淮安西湖舊編木捍沖激，勞費無已。

translations.literal: At Zhangqiu, Nanwang, and the old timber works of the West Lake at Huai'an, timber was constantly rebuilt to resist rushing water, with endless labor and expense.
translations.idiomatic: At Zhangqiu, Nanwang, and Huai'an West Lake, timber works constantly rebuilt against rushing water cost endless labor.

sentences.zh: 裕與郎中楊恭等謀，易以石，遂為永利。

translations.literal: Yu, together with Director Yang Gong and others, planned to replace them with stone, and thereafter the benefit was lasting.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yu and Director Yang Gong replaced them with stone, securing lasting benefit.

sentences.zh: 淮、鳳方饑，而太僕征預備馬二萬匹。

translations.literal: Huai and Feng were suffering famine, yet the Court of Imperial Studs was levying 20,000 reserve horses.
translations.idiomatic: While Huai and Feng suffered famine, the Court of Imperial Studs levied 20,000 reserve horses.

sentences.zh: 裕論罷之。

translations.literal: Yu argued and had the levy stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yu argued successfully to stop the levy.

sentences.zh: 在淮六歲，每歲入計事，陳利病，多施行。

translations.literal: During six years at Huai he entered the capital each year to report, presenting benefits and harms, and many measures were implemented.
translations.idiomatic: For six years at Huai he reported annually on benefits and harms, and many measures were implemented.

sentences.zh: 父憂歸，服除，留佐院事。

translations.literal: He returned home for his father's mourning; after the mourning period he remained to assist in court affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He mourned his father; after mourning he remained to assist in court affairs.

sentences.zh: 十九年代戴縉為右都御史。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he replaced Dai Jin as Right Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he replaced Dai Jin as Right Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 縉附汪直，嘗請復立西廠者也，在台綱紀不立。

translations.literal: Jin had attached himself to Wang Zhi and had once requested reestablishment of the Western Depot; discipline in the censorate was not maintained.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Jin had attached himself to Wang Zhi and once requested reestablishment of the Western Depot; censorate discipline collapsed.

sentences.zh: 裕欲振之。

translations.literal: Yu wished to restore it.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yu wished to restore discipline.

sentences.zh: 御史有過，或遭箠撻，由是得謗。

translations.literal: When censors erred they were sometimes beaten with rods; because of this he incurred slander.
translations.idiomatic: When censors erred he sometimes had them beaten; for this he was slandered.

sentences.zh: 汪直敗，偕副都御史屠滽請雪諸忤直得罪者。

translations.literal: When Wang Zhi fell, he joined Vice Censor-in-Chief Tu Fu in requesting rehabilitation for all who had offended Zhi and been punished.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Zhi fell, he joined Vice Censor-in-Chief Tu Fu in requesting rehabilitation for those punished for opposing Zhi.

sentences.zh: 帝不悅，奪俸。

translations.literal: The emperor was displeased and deducted his salary.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was displeased and deducted his salary.

sentences.zh: 又坐累，調南京都察院。

translations.literal: He was again penalized by cumulative offenses and transferred to the Nanjing Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: He was penalized again and transferred to the Nanjing Censorate.

sentences.zh: 考績赴都，留為工部尚書。

translations.literal: When his performance review took him to the capital, he was retained as Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: During his performance review in the capital, he was retained as Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 初，吏部尚書尹旻罷，耿裕代之。

translations.literal: At first, when Minister of Personnel Yin Min retired, Geng Yu replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: When Minister of Personnel Yin Min retired, Geng Yu replaced him.

sentences.zh: 以持正不為萬安所喜。

translations.literal: Because he was upright he was not favored by Wan An.
translations.idiomatic: Because he was upright he was not favored by Wan An.

sentences.zh: 而李孜省方貴幸用事，欲引鄉人，乃協謀去耿裕，以裕代之。

translations.literal: Li Zisheng was then favored and wielded power, wishing to bring in a fellow townsman; they therefore conspired to remove Geng Yu and replace him with Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zisheng was then in favor and wished to bring in a townsman; they removed Geng Yu and replaced him with Li Yu.

sentences.zh: 裕本廉介負時望，以孜省故，名頗損。

translations.literal: Yu had originally been incorrupt and enjoyed the esteem of the age, but because of Zisheng his reputation was rather damaged.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yu had been incorrupt and esteemed, but his reputation suffered because of Zisheng.

sentences.zh: 其銓敘亦平。

translations.literal: His appointments and promotions were nevertheless fair.
translations.idiomatic: His appointments were nevertheless fair.

sentences.zh: 故事，考察目有四：曰老疾，曰罷軟，曰貪酷，曰不謹。

translations.literal: By precedent, performance review categories were four: aged and ill, weak and incompetent, greedy and harsh, and careless.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent, performance review had four categories: aged and ill, weak and incompetent, greedy and harsh, and careless.

sentences.zh: 裕言：「人材質不同。

translations.literal: Yu said: "Human talent differs in quality.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yu said: "Human talent differs in quality.

sentences.zh: 偏執類酷，遲鈍類軟。

translations.literal: Obstinacy resembles harshness, and slowness resembles weakness.
translations.idiomatic: Obstinacy resembles harshness, and slowness resembles weakness.

sentences.zh: 乞立『才力不及』一途，以寓愛惜人才之意。

translations.literal: I beg that a path of insufficient talent and strength be established, to embody the intent of cherishing human talent.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that a category of insufficient talent and strength be established, to embody cherishing talent.

sentences.zh: 」帝善之，遂著為令。

translations.literal: The emperor approved this, and it was thereupon fixed as an ordinance.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved, and it was fixed as an ordinance.

sentences.zh: 考宗立，言官交章劾裕進由孜省。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaozong took the throne, remonstrating officials repeatedly impeached Yu for advancement through Zisheng.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaozong took the throne, remonstrators repeatedly impeached Li Yu for advancement through Zisheng.

sentences.zh: 裕不平，為《辨誣錄》，連疏乞休去。

translations.literal: Yu was resentful and compiled A Record to Refute Slander, memorializing repeatedly begging to retire.
translations.idiomatic: Resentful, Li Yu compiled A Record to Refute Slander and repeatedly begged to retire.

sentences.zh: 正德中卒，年八十八。

translations.literal: He died in the Zhengde period at the age of eighty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the Zhengde reign at the age of eighty-eight.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：王彰等或以性行未純，為時訾議。

translations.literal: The appraiser says: Wang Zhang and the others, some because their conduct was not wholly pure, were criticized by their contemporaries.
translations.idiomatic: The appraiser says: Wang Zhang and the others, some because their conduct was not wholly pure, drew contemporary criticism.

sentences.zh: 綜其生平，瑕瑜互見。

translations.literal: Considering their lives as a whole, flaws and merits appear side by side.
translations.idiomatic: Considering their lives as a whole, flaws and merits appear side by side.

sentences.zh: 然揚曆中外，勞績多有可紀。

translations.literal: Yet as they rose through central and outer posts, their labors and achievements were often worth recording.
translations.idiomatic: Yet as they rose through central and provincial service, their labors and achievements were often worth recording.

sentences.zh: 《書》稱「與人不求備」，《春秋》之義「善善長」，則諸人固不失為國家幹濟材歟。

translations.literal: The Book of Documents says, "Do not demand completeness in dealing with others," and the principle of the Spring and Autumn Annals is to "encourage goodness and make it grow"; then these men surely did not fail to be useful talents for the state.
translations.idiomatic: As the Book of Documents says, "Do not demand perfection in others," and the Spring and Autumn Annals principle is to "encourage goodness and let it grow"—these men surely remained useful servants of the state.
